artifacts.summary: Five sequential prose-tier phases (5.5h): re-verify the inventory anchors and open followup-scope-spec.md with a Section 0 verification record; write per-task revision Sections A-G including the REVISE resolution of the 711 tension; write the five new-task specs, ranking ratification and state-write disclosure; reconcile specs/ROADMAP.md with Phase 0 restated but undecided (Option A reading carried with its autonomous-adoption caveat); cross-file consistency and hard-constraint audit plus summary. No write to specs/state.json or specs/TODO.md.

memory_candidates.content: For a programme-review / reconciliation task whose research report already delivers the inventory and ranking, plan the implementation as a verification-then-transcription pipeline: (1) a grounding phase that re-runs every grep/#check the writes will cite and records literal outputs in a Section 0 of the specification file; (2) per-task revision sections; (3) new-task specs plus ranking and a state-write disclosure; (4) the programme document edit, citing the spec's section letters; (5) a cross-file sweep (declaration names resolve, typeclass hypotheses stated, negative statuses not softened, no complexity claims, no out-of-scope writes). Every fix the review finds outside the task's file_scope is routed into the spec's new-task section rather than applied -- this keeps the task inside its territory while a sibling dispatch runs on the shared tree. Phases are all prose-tier and fully sequential because they share one spec file and the roadmap text cites the spec.
